steps.title: Confirm, unlink and edit exact Unicode identity ranges
preconditions: Run the entire identity-boundaries group in fixed case order on the authorized automation Catalyst app with fresh synthetic storage. Existing review-and-edit workflow remains available separately.

Direction entries reuse the existing fixture envelope and deliberately have no timing words. No image-analysis, menu correction, stale-account/lease failure, pagination, final-text-only fallback or native visual parity assertion. Native results pending.
actions: Fresh ScrivSession.launch(app) via tracer app -- test --scenario journeys/text-identity-review --group identity-boundaries; capabilities requires public edit and observation commands; ready tabs; select Script; key command-s; persisted-projects must equal saved YAM MAN only.

For each case in fixed order import-json identityReviewInput converted to direction with words=[] and coverageDurationMs=3000 matching ownedDurationMs=3000, fresh UUID title and literal annotation(s); assert import result, revision=0, independent fixture payload, full loaded project and generated id differs from input.
Select Script; require displayed exact source; activate Review 1 character suggestion; activate Confirm; wait until no Confirm button.
Source literal "Randy waits.". Activate Unlink; require Kept unlinked; activate Find more name suggestions; require Kept unlinked and no Confirm.

snapshot requires source exact and read-only; persisted-projects unchanged while review open. Activate Save links; wait sheet dismissed; key command-s; exact revision +1; full independently expected confirmation/unlink model equality.

Require advertised command-Return; key command-Return; native editor first responder with exact text; reveal editor. selection target script-editor-identity-line start=0 end=0; script-insert text="👩‍💻 é "; result="👩‍💻 é Randy waits."; caret=9; explicit unlink identity-proposal location=9 length=5 text=Randy isConfirmed=true and absent characterId.

Observe script-interaction-counts before/after mutation; response exact public delegate contract; onTextEdit delta=1 and mergeAtStart delta=0; exact native text/caret; Escape finish; displayed exact; key command-s.

Assert revision +1 and finite nondecreasing modifiedAt; complete independently expected project including every unrelated field and annotation ID; loaded-project exact; unchanged creation/image Date bits; persisted-projects exact ordered prior packages plus result; presented-alerts=[]; capability runID unchanged. No mutation retries.

expectations.description: Complete independent saved/loaded model, exact annotation identity/range and UTF-16 native callback outcome.

mappings.why: Literal native edit and complete independently expected annotation model witness the admitted exact-edit/assign/save path. Numeric/underscore cases revoke token identity, duplicate deletion preserves the second identity, Unicode prefix shifts explicit unlink by nine UTF-16 units. Failure alternatives and final-text fallback remain unclaimed. Prepared static association; native execution results are recorded separately in docs/testing/coverage-goal-20261113.md.
